question: On which side of the wall may the outer-going boundary be placed?
premises: An outer-going wall boundary is under consideration.
Placement may be on the outside or on the inside.
inference: The boundary admits placement on either the outer or inner side of the wall.
uncertainties: The token ghrau is obscure and its technical role is unclear.
The token pi is read as a variant of api.
plain_english: The boundary going to the outside of the wall may be placed on the outside or also on the inside.
